description: Digital health solutions, telemedicine platforms, and health data systems serving patients and health workers in Sub-Saharan Africa, often in low-resource and offline settings.

infrastructure_context.power: Clinics often off-grid or unreliable power; solar fridges common for vaccines
infrastructure_context.connectivity: 2G/3G dominant in rural areas; offline-first data collection essential
infrastructure_context.devices: CHWs use feature phones or basic smartphones; BYOD common
infrastructure_context.logistics: Cold chain challenges; last-mile drug delivery difficult
infrastructure_context.literacy: Patients often low literacy; rely on voice/video or CHW intermediation

technology: Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) rules
